gloss: omission of courtesy; failing to send greetings

definitions.gloss: omission of courtesy; failing to send greetings
definitions.explanation: A failure or omission of an expected courtesy. Most commonly refers to not sending New Year's cards ({年賀状|ねんがじょう}) because one is in mourning ({喪中|もちゅう}). The verb is {欠礼|けつれい}する.

examples.japanese: ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧{欠礼|けつれい}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I will refrain from greetings due to mourning.

examples.japanese: {欠礼|けつれい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦お{知|し}らせ→お知らせ：18843_oshirase⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: to send a notice of omitted greetings

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{亡|な}くなった→亡くなる：02639_nakunaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{年賀|ねんが}→年賀：11175_nenga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{欠礼|けつれい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦お{詫|わ}びします→お詫びする：28881_owabisuru⟧。
examples.english: As my father passed away this year, I apologize for omitting New Year's greetings.

notes:
Often used in the set phrase {欠礼|けつれい}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧ (or {欠礼|けつれい}{葉書|はがき}), the postcard sent in late autumn to tell people one will not send ⟦{年賀状|ねんがじょう}→年賀状：06227_nengajou⟧ this year because of a death in the family.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {欠礼|けつれい}⟦{状|じょう}→状：09878_jou⟧: card announcing omitted greetings
- ⟦{年賀|ねんが}→年賀：11175_nenga⟧{欠礼|けつれい}: omission of New Year's greetings
- ⟦{喪中|もちゅう}→喪中：06226_mochuu⟧{欠礼|けつれい}: omission of greetings during mourning

USAGE:
A polite, formal word; {欠礼|けつれい}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means to forgo an expected courtesy.
